As the evidence given by the sole eye witness contains serious doubt and ambiguity over the prosecution version, this ground itself is enough to succeed the appeal. This Court finds that if the prosecution has allowed access to the evidence in terms of section 7 of the Evidence (Special Provisions) Act, a trial Court has no basis to reject it.
